apiKey.title: Octopus API Key
apiKey.description: Create an API key in your Octopus Energy account. The Homebridge UI stores this value in its plugin configuration.

accountNumber.title: Octopus Account Number (recommended for live data)
accountNumber.description: Your account number in A-12345678 format. Used to discover the Home Mini electricity meter device ID automatically.

pollSeconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: Defaults to 30 seconds with a Home Mini device ID, otherwise 300 seconds. Octopus rate-limits live telemetry, so values below 30 seconds are not allowed.

homeMiniDeviceId.title: Home Mini Electricity Meter Device ID (optional)
homeMiniDeviceId.description: Optional override for the electricity meter EUI64 device ID, for example 12-34-5A-FF-FF-6B-C7-89. Normally discovered from the account number.

gas.title: Gas Meter (Optional)
gas.description: Octopus gas data is published in half-hour intervals and displayed as energy in kWh. Gas uses an MPRN, not an MPAN.

mprn.title: MPRN
mprn.description: Meter Point Reference Number for the gas supply.

unit.title: Consumption Unit
unit.description: This is the native API unit used for conversion. Automatic uses the Octopus account data. SMETS1 is normally kWh; SMETS2 is normally cubic metres. The displayed result is always kWh.
